_comment: azd parameter wiring for infra/bicep/main.bicep (issue #67, Phase 1). azd substitutes ${VAR} from the selected environment's .env (set via `azd env set <VAR> <value>`) during `azd provision`/`azd up`, then passes the resolved values to Bicep. NO subscription/tenant/resource-group/secret is hardcoded — all values are non-secret. Only the env-driven parameters are wired here; imageTag (latest) and manageStateImmutabilityPolicy (true) intentionally fall back to main.bicep's own defaults. authMode is set EXPLICITLY to 'disabled' here as the Phase-1 DELIVERED default (Option 3, issue #127): safe ONLY because the API is internal-only (network-isolated, not publicly exposed). This does NOT change main.bicep's own authMode default, which stays 'required' (fail-closed) for anyone deploying main.bicep directly. To harden, set authMode to 'required' plus WP_AUTH_TENANT_ID/WP_AUTH_AUDIENCE — see the 'Enable required auth (hardening)' section of docs/delivery/customer-deployment.md.
